You will be instrumental in shaping the strategic direction and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

This is an urgent and highly valued position within our organization. We are prepared to offer a competitive compensation package, including a significant bonus, to attract a leader who can make an immediate impact. If you are a results-oriented professional with a proven track record in multi-facility healthcare operations, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Proven experience in multi-facility operational leadership within the healthcare sector.
Strong financial acumen and P&L management experience.
Demonstrated ability to drive operational efficiency and quality outcomes.
Exceptional leadership and team development skills.
Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Management, or a related field.
salaryOrBonusInfo: $120,000 - $160,000 per year plus bonus potential. Compensation will be highly competitive and may exceed the stated range for an exceptional candidate.

description:
We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Regional MDS Coordinator to oversee Minimum Data Set (MDS) processes across multiple skilled nursing facilities in Oklahoma. This pivotal role offers a competitive salary of $100,000 - $110,000 per year, plus bonus, for a professional ready to make a significant impact on resident care and facility compliance.

As a Regional MDS Coordinator, you will ensure accurate and timely completion of MDS assessments, optimize reimbursement, and maintain compliance with state and federal regulations. This is an excellent opportunity to join a leading skilled nursing organization and contribute your expertise to multiple teams, with the potential for increased compensation for the ideal candidate.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Oklahoma.
Minimum Data Set (MDS) certification (RAC-CT preferred).
Proven experience as an MDS Coordinator, with multi-facility oversight experience.
In-depth knowledge of the RAI manual and Medicare/Medicaid regulations.
Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: $100,000 - $110,000 per year plus bonus. Compensation is negotiable and will be higher for the right candidate.
